title: 13-year-old child actor stabbed 8 times by 15-year-old neighbor in QC
summary: A 13-year-old child actor sustained multiple stab wounds after he was allegedly attacked by his 15-year-old neighbor in Barangay Payatas, Quezon City, on October 12, according to police.
